insight: Founded by ex-HubSpot chief product officer Christopher O'Donnell; raised a $20M Series A led by Sequoia for an AI-native CRM.
name: Day.ai
tagline: AI-native CRM that builds itself from your email, calls, and Slack — no manual data entry.
description: Day.ai is an AI-native CRM that automatically captures and reasons over customer interactions instead of relying on manual data entry. It listens across Gmail/Outlook, Slack, and video meetings — joining Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls to record, transcribe, and update records — and layers on AI assistants that prep meetings, manage pipelines, and draft follow-ups. Founders describe it as 'the Cursor of CRM,' aimed at replacing the heavy manual interfaces of legacy systems.
edge: Built AI-native by HubSpot's former CPO — it auto-captures CRM data from email, Slack, and calls, so the record stays current without manual entry.
pros: Auto-captures data from email, Slack, calls
cons: Usage caps can limit larger teams
Fits solo reps more than big sales orgs

references.title: This Startup Raised $20M From Sequoia To Build 'The Cursor Of CRM'
